findings: Sign convention unstated and apparently inverted. §4 asserts a positive reference sigma_bar_yy = F/(400t) = +15.625 MPa and Ny -> +50,000 N, but §3 places the loaded arc endpoints at (160,220) and (240,220) with the lowest hole point at y=180, i.e. the loaded arc is the LOWER half of a hole centred at (200,220), r=40. Pressure on the lower hole surface bears downward into the plate, which puts the y=90 section in compression (sigma_yy < 0). The plan never states the applied load direction. An assessor coded RED against +50,000 N would reject a physically correct result and burn an irreplaceable licensed invocation. Pin the load direction, derive the expected sign, and make the sign an explicit RED case before any native capture.

Thickness representation not pinned. W = integral(t p n.u ds), Ny = t*integral(sigma_yy dx) and the W ~ 2Ue gate all scale linearly with t=8.000 mm, but the plan never names how thickness enters the frozen deck (PLANE182 KEYOPT(3)=3 with real-constant thickness vs KEYOPT(3)=0 unit thickness, and whether F=50,000 N is total or per unit thickness). If the frozen model is unit-thickness, the independent work integral is 8x the FE work and the 0.1% energy gate fails only AFTER a budgeted solve. This must be verified offline from the frozen input deck and asserted in a RED test.

Vx -> 0 and Mc -> 0 rest on an unverified symmetry assumption. Both targets follow only if the load resultant is vertical and its line of action is exactly x=200. §3 concedes the polygonal hole geometry changes with refinement, and the 5 mm / 2.5 mm meshes are regenerated, so discrete polygon asymmetry about x=200 can produce nonzero Vx and Mc that are attributed to recovery error. Add an offline check on the emitted native node coordinates that the loaded-arc polygon and its pressure law are symmetric about x=200 at each level, before the solve.

Tolerances are a single pair (50 N, 2,000 N mm) applied to quantities whose expected error magnitudes differ by many orders. Discrete reaction/applied-force equilibrium is an identity of the assembled system and should close to ~1e-8 relative; a 50 N gate on 50,000 N (1e-3) is far too loose to detect any real modelling defect there. Conversely |Ny - 50,000| <= 50 N is a 0.1% demand on a nodal-AVERAGED, path-interpolated recovered stress on a 10 mm mesh, with no discretization error estimate offered anywhere in the document. Neither number is derived. Combined with the explicit 'no post-hoc relaxation' and 'failure stops the campaign' rules, a mis-calibrated recovery tolerance terminates the study on invocation 1. Derive each gate per quantity from its expected error source and record the derivation in the frozen criteria version.

The printed-precision argument bounds the wrong error. §4 makes a pass conditional on 'propagated worst-case rounding' from a fixed E25.16 print format. MAPDL stores results-file real data in single precision unless double-precision results output is explicitly enabled; E25.16 formatting confers no accuracy the .rst does not hold. The dominant uncertainty is storage plus summation over thousands of SENE terms, not decimal print rounding. Either enable and verify double-precision results output, or re-derive the uncertainty budget from storage precision; as written the 'fail-closed on uncertainty' mechanism is decorative.

Sensitivity gate is internally inconsistent and under-specified. Requiring |C3-C2| < |C2-C1| IS a monotone-decrement convergence assumption, which §3 and the same row disclaim on the grounds that the polygonal boundary and load also refine. The two ratios use different denominators (r12 = |C2-C1|/C2 but r23 = |C3-C2|/C3), so they are not comparable. Exact equality C1=C2=C3 fails the strict inequality, and the precedence between the strict-inequality branch and the 'both <= 1e-6 => insensitive' branch is not stated. Specify the decision as explicit ordered logic with one normalization, and justify or drop the decrement requirement.

Invocation budget has no completion path. The five permitted invocations are exactly consumed (2 fine preparations + 3 responses), yet native output-format qualification is bundled into budgeted capture 1, and an unsupported format 'will fail that capture and require a reviewed amendment before another native attempt'. The amendment is not stated to restore budget, so a single format surprise makes the campaign unfinishable while still having spent a seat. Format/interface qualification against v261 (PDEF component availability, ETABLE SENE membership, E-format behaviour) should be a separate, explicitly non-budgeted, no-physics probe run first, or the amendment clause must state budget restoration.

No acceptance criterion addresses the question that motivates the study. The stated concern is whether the global stress maximum is singularity-driven at the clamped/free corners, but the global peak equivalent stress and its behaviour across 10/5/2.5 mm are only 'retained diagnostics' with no recorded expectation, no h-dependence criterion and no disposition. The campaign can pass every gate in Table 3 and still return nothing about the singularity hypothesis. Add an explicit recorded expectation for peak-stress growth with refinement and state what outcome would and would not support the singularity classification.

PATH sampling feasibility unverified. 1,600 divisions must be checked against the v261 PATH/PPATH division ceiling before the criteria are frozen; exceeding it turns the finest sampling grid into a silent truncation or a run failure. Separately, the mesh around a polygonal hole is plausibly unstructured, so y=90 may cut element interiors rather than lie on element boundaries; the 400->800->1,600 trapezoid-convergence gate assumes a sampled field whose kink locations are resolved. Confirm y=90 boundary alignment per level, or justify the gate on a C0 field with unresolved kinks.

Operational and governance gaps: (a) 'An unexpected process after timeout will retain the seat lock until its identity and disposition are resolved' names no owner, timebox or escalation, so a hung process indefinitely blocks the exclusive licensed seat; (b) no disposition is defined for a partial campaign (stop after the 5 mm level leaves C3 undefined and the sensitivity gate inapplicable, yet artifacts and receipts exist); (c) T2 is declared for five new/modified source and test modules plus a new native execution harness and irreversible licensed-seat consumption, with no justification against the T3 criteria for cross-cutting or systemic scope.
